interpretations.statement: Unreviewed interpretation: [TRUE_IS_PROHIBITED] For the selected paragraph-10 gift-promotion control, an in-scope distributor’s offered gift is prohibited when its terms or operation link it to promoting a specific product or particular product type and it is not a fee-or-charge discount. False means this selected prohibition is not triggered under this reading, not that the campaign is otherwise compliant.
